items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Glen Pack, him and Harry White was the three horns.

ctx.x: He was disgusted in New York, he said, 'I'm going to Europe,' and he went to Europe. He never did come back. He died in Switzerland. The trumpet player was named Ted...Ted something. He had been with Leroy Smith's band. He was a legitimate trumpet player who played a little Jazz. But he was a linguist, spoke six or seven languages. He worked for the State Department. He was a very polished man, and I sat next to him... Glen Pack, him and Harry White was the three horns. Lloyd Phillips, who later played with...
